_about: Monochrome Cinema variant from Top-100 rank 72 (r29, snippco, 16:9 source, 9 s; templated for vertical). The FAST, YELLOW member: heroes are big golden-yellow words that mix bold sans and serif italic ('bis-nis', 'on-line'), with a tiny tagline under them; everything else is one small white word at a time in the centre of frame. Very quick picture changes over varied lifestyle b-roll (plane window, gym, money falling, landscape), one inverted-colour flash frame. Warm, contrasty grade, not B&W. Measured: 98 picture changes/min (every 0.78 s), caption every 0.41 s, captions 47% down, luma 74, sat 99 (source has no audio).
